import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Clean Category: strip whitespace and standardize case
    df = df.copy()
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Map known mislabelings to correct categories
    category_mapping = {
        'Electrials': 'Electricals',
        'Accesosries': 'Accessories',
        'Ofifce Supplies': 'Office Supplies',
        'O\bF\bF\bI\bC\bE\b \bS\bU\bP\bP\bL\bI\bE\bS': 'Office Supplies',
        'O\bU\bT\bD\bO\bR\b \bS\bU\bP\bP\bL\bI\bE\bS': 'Outdoor Supplies',
        'F\bU\bR\bN\bI\bT\bU\bR\bE': 'Furniture',
        'E\bL\bE\bC\bT\bR\bO\bN\bI\bC\bS': 'Electronics'
    }
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].replace(category_mapping)
    
    # Clean Region: strip whitespace and standardize case
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Fix common typos in Region
    region_mapping = {
        'Weest': 'West',
        'Suotheast': 'Southeast',
        'Southh': 'South',
        'Souuth': 'South',
        'Nort': 'North',
        'orth': 'North',
        'EAST': 'East',
        'NORTHEAST': 'Northeast',
        'nORTHEAST': 'Northeast'
    }
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].replace(region_mapping)
    
    # Clean Price: remove non-numeric characters and convert to float
    df['Price'] = df['Price'].str.replace('[^\\d.]', '', regex=True).astype(float)
    
    return df
